title: Claude Code skills you are not using (fork, $ARGUMENTS, triggers)
description: Most people using Claude Code skills never touch the parts that actually matter. Forked context windows that run on their own model. $ARGUMENTS so a slash command takes parameters. And descriptions written well enough the skill actually fires when you need it instead of sitting there unused. Get those three right and your skills go from decoration to something you reach for every day. Full writeup plus the 7 I would install first - link in bio.
